title: pilea cuneiformis
intro: Pilea cuneiformis, commonly known as the aluminum plant or flat shield plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilea cuneiformis include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, cough, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
